about: Width-gate budgets per box variant (pipeline.md §Width gate). px = widest text in pixels (width table 0x4645B8 advances), bytes = hard byte cap, lines = lines per page. status: measured (with shot/evidence) or guess. Tables map script/<table>.json to a variant; a string shown on several screens takes the smallest budget.

dialogue.evidence: engine wraps words at pen x > 0xD0 (0x080414BA); 26 VRAM columns x 8 px; the visible last column at 208 px is still to be confirmed on a zoomed marker_full shot (build.py --marker --full); torture line work/qa/stress/party_parts/arrived.png
